metaDescription: Order custom copper awards recognition for your team. Bulk pricing on engraved copper plaques and medals at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Copper awards recognition pieces bring a warm, distinctive luster that sets them apart from standard gold or silver options. The reddish-brown tones develop a natural patina over time, adding character that commemorates long-term achievement or service milestones. Perfect for engraved plaques or custom medals like the Laurel Wreath Medal, copper offers a unique look that stands out in any display case. Bulk ordering ensures consistent quality across your entire recognition program.
